tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun rig gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi cho ga'i lung sbyor rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan gu ru mahā bai ro tsa na ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal bla ma rnam par snang mdzad chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rje dang dkyil 'khor gtso/ /dbyer med zhabs la phyag btsal nas/ /'dir ni gzhan phan mtha' yas la/ /lung sbyor rin chen phreng ba spel/ /de la 'dir lha khang la sogs pa'i don ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ gtsug lag khang dang skyed mos tshal/ /mchod rten lha khang kun dga' sogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sogs ni/ lang ka rgyal bzang gis/ dkyil 'khor bri bar ma nus na/ /dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras gzhi la/ /nges par dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ni/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan rdzogs par bri/ /zhes so/ /mchod yon sngon du sogs kyi mchod yon ni/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ nas dang 'bras yol til dang ni/ /tsandan dkar po dang ldan zhing / /me tog 'o ma dri zhim bcas/ /mchod yon snod du bzhag par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /snod kyang gser dang dngul dang nya phyis dang / /rdo dang shing dang zangs ma'i snod/ /'di dag mchod yon snod yin te/ /mthar yang 'dab ma'i snod sbyar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'dab ma'i don/ lte ba sum cha tha ma sum gnyis byas pa'i bal ting kha khyer med pa yin la/ zhabs bsil dngos su ma bshad kyang / phyag len la dri bzang po btab pa'i chu shar lhor 'jog 'bul ba'i tshig bde bar gshegs so sogs yin gsungs/ mchod yon ni shar du'o/ /lhor me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / lho nub tu spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri mchog byang du zhal zas/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog rnams so/ /gzhan mchod rdzas bum pa gtor ma rnams ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas mkhas pas dkyil 'khor la/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dang / /gdugs dang rnga yab lda ldi dang /

/'phan dang sna tshogs na bzas mchod/ /gser las byas pa'i bya rnams ni/ /brgyad dam bcu drug lhag kyang rung / /dbang bskur rin chen chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa lnga ni bzhag par bya/ /mar me gtor ma bum pa dang / /mdzes pa'i bshos rnams bzhag bya ste/ /bza' bar rung ba sbyar legs dang / /bca' ba sna tshogs bzhag par bya/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs bzhag /'byung po che dang lha dang klu/ /mi dang mi min de bzhin te/ /me tog dri rnams sna tshogs dang / /'o ma mar dang ka rar bcas/ /rnam rgyal bum pa dri yi chus/ /rab tu bkang ba bzhag par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sgrub pa po sogs kyi don ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas khrus la sogs byas la/ /dri dang phreng mchog phreng ba can/ /dri zhim kha bkang mchog mdzes pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas kyang / /me tog thogs te sgo phyogs 'dug /ces so/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje me'i sngags rgya'i dgos pa ni/ legs grub las/ khro bo'i gsang sngags rgyar bcas pa'i/ /me tog la sogs rnam par bsang / /zhes gsungs pas/ me tog 'bul tshe/ log 'dren me tog cher bkod dang / bdug pa la nag po lus chen/ mar me la gtsug phud gcig pa/ dri mchog la zas su dri za ba rnams kyi bgegs dang / gzhan yang zas su me tog bza' ba dang / sogs kyi bgegs yod pas de dag bsrung ba'i phyir yin no/ /bsrungs pas zhi bar 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'gyur te/ dpung bzang las/ bgegs dang log 'dren rnam par gzhom pa'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi thabs sbyor drag shul las kyang sbyar/ /sngags pa de yis gsang sngags lam zhugs pas/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rnams kyis yongs mi tshugs/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje me yi sngags rgyas ngan pa'i dngos po bsreg gzi brjid dang phun sum tshogs pa bskyed/ oṃ swa ni mchod rdzas/ sems dpa' 'byung ba las/ yi ge oṃ las rin chen sna bdun dang /

dpag bsam gyi shing dang / kha zas ro brgya pa'i mchod pa sprul nas zhes dang / rnam snang sgyu dra'i 'grel par/ rdo rje me tog la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang / sngags yongs su bzlas pa'i me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang / byug pa so so'i gsang sngags brjod cing / dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad mchod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje dril bu dkrol ba'i sngags/ rnam snang sgyu drar/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pa ra mi ta na da sam̐ bha we/ badzra dharmā hri da ya santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de bod skad du bsgyur na/ rdo rje dril bu'i sgra sgrog cing / rab tu sgra sgrog pa/ yang dag par sgra rab tu sgrog pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rab tu g.yo ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgra'i ngo bo/ rdo rje chos kyi thugs kun nas dgyes pa/ oṃ gyi don ni/ rdo rje rtse mor/ oṃ ni ci zhig yin par brjod/ /mchog dang nor ster dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes dang / /yi ge hūm̐ ni ci zhig brjod/ /sdug bsngal 'joms shing 'chos par byed/ /srid pa'i zhags pa gcod byed cing / /gdug pa gdangs shing gsod byed pa'i/ /hūm̐ ni mchog tu dran par bya/ /zhes so/ /sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i dang pos sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs par bsam/ gnyis pas de rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ gsum pas kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar bsam mo/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten dang rtsa ba yin no/ /chos thams cad sogs ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs 'gyur ba/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ /zhes gsungs la/ de sgom tshul ni/

dpung bzang las/ sna rtser blta zhing rnam par rtog pa spongs/ /nam zhig bskyod kyang rnam par mi g.yo ba/ /de tshe dmigs pa gnas pa thob pa ste/ /sems ni las su rung bar 'gyur bar nges/ /rtse gcig sems dang ldan pa'i mi la ni/ /yid las byung ba'i dga' ba rab tu skye/ /dga' bas lus ni shin tu sbyangs pa thob/ /lus sbyangs pas ni bde ba'i skal ldan 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /rang nyid rdo rje sems sogs ni/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor dag /tshig tsam gyis kyang rtag tu bya/ /zhes dpal mchog gis gsungs/ lce lag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ de nyid 'dus par/ lce la rdo rje dge bsgoms na/ /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gtsug dgu'i gzhung las rdo rje'i lce ru rab bsams pas/ /sngags bzlos mthu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'byung bar/ lag pa'i sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje rtse lnga par bsam la bgegs bsal ba sogs bya'o/ /zhes dang / gtsug dgur/ rdo rje lag par gyur pa ni phyag rgya 'ching bar nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /hūm̐ las bdag nyid sogs ni/ rdo rje rtse mor/ gsod dang skrod dang drag po ste/ /de ni khro bo'i don du brjod/ /nga ni rdo rje me ltar 'bar/ /nyon mongs thams cad sreg par byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ bsnun bsregs bcings gsum byed pa la khro bo me ltar 'bar ba nges par dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i sku mdog phyag mtshan ni/ dpal mchog las/ sngon po 'bar ba'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gtsigs/ /zhal ni khro dang bcas par bzhad/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis legs bzhugs/ /snyems can shas cher 'bar ba la/ /'od zer 'bar ba 'khrug pa yis/ /rdo rje gsor bar mdzad la brtson/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gṛhṇa sogs bsgyur nas/ zungs shig rdo rje'i dam tshig bam̐ chings shig oṃ badzra sogs/ rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba nyi ma'i gzi brjid can/

mngon par dbang bskur ba bdag la/ oṃ truṃ ni rtse mor/ don kun rab tu sgrub byed pa'i/ /yig gnyis go cha bzang po yin/ /tu ṣya ho zhes pa mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas sngar yod kyi bgegs bsal ba dang / phyin chad mi 'jug pa'i srung 'khor bsgom pa las/ me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags rgyas bgegs la bsnun cing bsad par bsam/ bsnun kyang ma shi zhing mi 'bros pa'i bgegs rnams rdo rje me'i sngags rgyas bsreg par bya ste/ hūm̐ badzra dzwa la sogs bsgyur na/ rdo rje me ltar 'bar bsnun bsreg tshos chom nyed par gyis/ rtse mor/ yi ge phaṭ ni ci yin brjod/ /nyon mongs gdug pa ltung byed cing / /zhi ba 'gugs pa yin par bshad/ /phaṭ ces bya ba ltung ba'i sgra/ /ngan 'gro ba ltung ba po/ zhes so/ /rdo rje las me'i 'od 'phros pas bgegs bsregs par bsam/ me lha'i bgegs la sogs pa mes mi tshig pa rnams lus ngag yid gsum bcings nas 'gul mi nus par bsam/ rdo rje spyan ma bgegs thams cad chings shig pa'o/ /dgos pa ni/ rtse mor/ bgegs bcings pa ni ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje khu tshur rab 'bar ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma rab 'bar dang / /rdo rje spyan ma'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs bcing pa ni brtan par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /phyin chad mi 'jug pa ni/ de ltar da ltar yod pa'i bgegs rnams tshar chod kyang / /'ga' zhig shi nas bgegs su skye ba srid pas/ de mi 'jug pa'i phyir srung 'khor bya ba la/ rdo rjer spro ba dang / khro bor spro ba gnyis las/ rdo rjer spro ba'i lugs ni/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud las/ rdo rje bsdams pa thur du bstan te brkyangs pa sa la bzhag ste/ 'dis rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur te/ de la sus kyang glags mi rnyed do/ /zhes dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi 'grel par/ rdo rje bsdams pa brkyangs pa sa la reg pas sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/

/zhes te/ sngags bsgyur na/ rdo rje brtan pa bdag la kun du bsrung bar mdzod cig rtse mor/ swahā zhes pa ci yin brjod/ sdig pa thams cad zhi byed cing / /dge ba'i tshogs ni 'phel bar byed/ /nyes par byas pa 'phrog byed cing / /sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms pa'i mchog /ces so/ /bcings pa zhes bya ba ni/ rnam snang sgyu tra'i 'grel par/ mngon par 'dod pa'i sa'i cha kun nas rab tu rdo rje 'bar bas bar mtshams med par khyab pas bdag gir byas pa'i tshul lo/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed can gyi sngags rgyas steng rdo rje'i thog gru bzhir bsams pa/ sngags don sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi 'grel pa rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad par/ hu lu hu lu ni zhugs shig par bshad la/ sgron gsal du/ hu lu hu lu ni rings shing rings par zhes bshad cing / shanti pas/ hu lu ni kye ma ho zhes bshad do/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas/ yang de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i thog ste nyis rim mo/ /rdo rje gtsug tor gyi sngags rgyas shar phyogs rdo rje'i rtsig pa thog gong ma dang sbrel bar bsam/ druṃ ni sa bon no/ /rdo rje zhags pa'i sngags rgyas/ shar phyogs rdo rje'i rtsig pa thog 'og ma dang sbrel bar bsam/ man snyer/ hri ni gsal por gyis shig pa ste/ nye ba ma yin pa nye bar gyur pa gsal por gyis shig pa'o/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje ba dan gyi sngags rgyas/ nub phyogs rdo rje'i rtsig pa thog 'og ma dang sbrel bar bsgom/ sngags don/ rdo rje ba dan zhes bos nas/ pa tam̐ ba dan can no/ /ni ra ṭa nges par chod cig go /rdo rje dus ma'i sngags rgyas/ byang phyogs rdo rje'i rtsig pa thog 'og ma dang sbrel bar bsgom/ hrī ni sa bon no/ /rdo rje dus ma'i zhes bos nas tuṭa chod cig phaṭ rlogs shig gam choms shig go /rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi mnyam sbyor rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel par/ ru tuṭa ma ṭa ni dga' ba dang bral ba'o/

/zhes so/ /rtse mor/ de nas steng 'og mtshams rnams su'o/ /rdo rje nag mos nges par bcings/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i sngags rgyas/ lho phyogs rdo rje'i rtsig pa thog 'og ma dang sbrel bar bsgom/ steng dang shar gnyis lan gnyis bcing ba ni/ mgon po kun snang gi rgyud las/ tshangs dang brgya byin mthu che bas/ /steng dang shar gnyis lan gnyis bcings/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje las kyi sngags rgyas/ de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum por bsam/ yang hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas de'i nang du rdo rje'i rwa ba nyis rim bsam/ lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje'i bum brtsigs su bzhed/ rtse mor/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje ra bas bcing bar bya/ /hūm̐ mdzad rdo rjes bsdig par bya/ /de ni rdo rje 'bar bas bskor/ /zhes so/ /oṃ badzra bandha bam̐ zhes pas/ ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i gur bsam ste/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi dkyil chog tu/ rdo rje bsdams pas rdo rje'i ra ba bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /pañtsa ram̐ zhes pa la lo tsā ba chen po'i slob dpon shākya blo gros kyis gzeb tu bsgyur/ lo tsā ba chen pos dra bar bsgyur/ 'brog mi lo tsā bas gur du bsgyur/ de rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ kun nas yongs su zlum por ni/ /ra ba dra ba byas nas kyang / /zhes dang / de nyid snang chen las/ de las dra ba ni ra ba dang 'tshams par steng g.yogs kyi rdo rje'i gzeb bri ba'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /lugs 'di la khro bo spyan 'dren bstod pa/ bka' bsgo sogs mi dgos so/ /lugs 'di slob dpon kun dga' snying pos rdo rje 'byung ba'i gzhung sogs su bshad do/ /khro bor spro ba'i lugs ni/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed can gyi sngags brjod cing phyag rgya bstan pas/ grub sde gcig pa'i tshul gyis/ steng du rdo rje 'jigs byed dkar po/

g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas/ steng du rdo rje gnod sbyin sngon po/ g.yas phag rgod kyi mche ba 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi sngags rgyas/ shar du rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rdo rje zhags pa'i sngags rgyas/ shar du rdo rje zhags pa ser po/ g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rdo rje ba dan gyi sngags rgyas/ nub tu ba dan dmar po/ g.yas ba dan 'dzin pa/ rdo rje dus ma'i sngags rgyas/ byang du rdo rje dus ma nag mo/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i phag rgod kyi mche ba 'dzin pa/ mchan na kha ṭwām̐ ga zer ba 'dug rdo rje rtse mo'i sngags rgyas/ lhor rdo rje rtse mo sngon po/ g.yas ri rab 'dzin pa/ g.yon thams cad thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums/ g.yon brkyangs ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gtsug dga'i gzhung du/ 'og 'ching ba'i sngags 'dir bshad cing / paṇḍi ta mngon shes can gyis/ mtshan brjod dkyil chog tu/ badzra dṛ ḍha'i sngags kyi/ 'og tu rdo rje tho ba smug nag bsgom pa gsungs na'ang / 'dir mi byed/ dkyil chog de nyid las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed gnod byin gyi/ /steng gi phyogs su rnam par gtams/ /rdo rje gtsug tor zhags pa yi/ /shar gyi phyogs su rnam par gtams/ /nub phyogs su ni ba dan te/ /byang du rdo rje nag mo ste/ /lho ru rdo rje rtse mo ste/ /'og tu rdo rje tho bas gtams/ /phyogs mtshams hūm̐ mdzad ra ba las/ /rdo rje las kyi go mig gtsags/ /'jigs su rung ba 'di dag la/ /phyi rol ye shes me ri 'bar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lugs 'di lo tsā ba chen po'i slob ma rnams khro bo rnams de ltar bskyed nas/ spyan 'dren bstod pa/ bka' bsgo ba rnams byed pa yin no/ /khro bo spro ba'i lugs 'di slob dpon kun dga' snying pos/

gsang 'dus yo gar bkral pa'i 'grel par bshad cing / sangs rgyas gsang ba/ pradzñā ba li ta sogs rgya gar ba phal che ba lugs 'di 'dod pa yin no/ /khro bo spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad 'di dag lo chen gyi slob ma pu hrang pa zla 'od dang / grags pa yon tan sogs kyis rnam 'joms bstod pa bre nor bu rdo rjes mdzad pa sogs la rtsom stan byas sam snyam mo/ /de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi mar/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bcings nas kyang / /snying kha mdzod spu mgrin spyi bo/ /bzhag pa nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog tu/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ bzhi pas/ snying kha dang / dpral ba dang / lkog ma dang / spyi bor bdag nyid byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /zhes bsgyur na/ gnod mdzes nges par gnod mdzes/ zungs zungs/ zung cig gnyis/ 'gugs par gyis/ bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po/ sems dpa' bzhi'i bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje 'byung bar/ rdo rje bsrung ba dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje khu tshur dang / rdo rje las kyi dam rgya dang sngags kyi bdag nyid la bsrung bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sngags rgya de nyid las 'byung ba ltar te/ rakṣa ham̐/ yakṣa hūm̐/ santi bam̐/ zhes dang / sbyong rgyud kyi rakṣa ram̐ gnyis ma nor ba gal che'o/ /rdo rje rtse mor/ de nas phyag rgya brtan par byed pa ni/ oṃ badzra satwa sogs yig brgyas brtan par gsungs pa ltar/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod pa'i dang po dang gnyis pa la rdo rje gsor/ dril bu bcad btub tu dkrol ba lan gsum gsum sogs byed/ gsum pa la dril bu sku gsung thugs 'gro ba'i don mdzod cig ces pa'i dkrol stabs dang / rdo rje dril bu la g.yas bskor du dal bus bskor bar mdzad do/ /yig brgya gsum gyi bar la rdor dril 'dzin dkrol gyi phyag len 'di/

chos rje rin rnam pa'i yig cha bzhin bkod pa yin la/ phyag len la/ yig brgya dang po la rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag dkrol dang / gnyis pa la dril bu de ka'i ngang nas rdo rje dril bu la g.yas skor du bskor/ gsum pa la rdo rje snying ka dang / dril bu gsum brdung du mdzad pa yin no/ /'di la da lta'i lag len pa rnams dkrol lugs nges pa mi snang zhing / rnam bshad rnams su yang 'dra min kho na 'byung ngo / /yig brgya bsgyur na/ rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig rjes su skyongs shig rdo rje sems dpa' nye bar mnos pa/ bdag la brtan pa'i rang bzhin/ bdag la dga' ba'i rang bzhin/ bdag la mdzes pa'i rang bzhin/ bdag la rjes su chags pa'i rang bzhin/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ bdag la las thams cad stsol/ bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rjes bdag ma gtong zhig rdo rje'i rang bzhin chen po dam tshig sems dpa' zhes so/ /lha 'grub pa'i rgyu bsgom pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs nas/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis byin gyis brlabs par bsam ste hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang / a zhes bya bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo gnyis ka la a la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu drug gi kun tu bkang zhing 'phro bar bya ste/ mthe bong gnyis la oṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ gung mo gnyis la tram̐ zhes bya ba bsam/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūm̐ zhes bya ba bsam/ srin lag gnyis la hri zhes bya ba bsam/ mthe'u chung gnyis la a zhes bya ba bsam/ de ltar yi ge rnams bsam par byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos pa bskyed de/ chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa dang / bdag dang yang dag rjes su mthun par byas te/ lag pa g.yas par sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i sa bon hūm̐ dang /

g.yon du shes rab skye ba med pa stong pa nyid mtshon pa'i yi ge a zhes bya ba bsam/ dum bu gnyis pa'i dkyil chog las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo thams cad kyi sku bdag nyid la gzugs brnyan du snang bas rgyal po'i bka' ltar 'da' bar dka' zhing / gzhig mi nus pas phyag rgya bcings pa dang / sngags brjod pa thams cad la rgyal ba thams cad kyis kyang rdo rje ltar 'da' bar mi mdzad pa'i lha'i nga rgyal sngon du bskyed cing / phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /zhes so/ /lag pa zla ba sogs su bsgom pa 'di la gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba zhes grags so/ /phyag rgya 'ching ba la'ang phyag rgya bcings pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga dang / phyag rgya bcings pa grub pa'i cho ga gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzugs can gyi sbyor ba dang / mnyam pa'i thal mo dang / rdo rje bsdams pa dang / bsdams pa bral ba ste/ sdig pa bral ba la ye shes 'bebs pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na rigs ngan gyi khyim bsregs na bram ze 'byon pa bzhin/ sdig pa bral ba la rdo rje bsdams pa dgos/ de la rdo rje thal mo dang mnyam pa'i thal mo dgos/ de la gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi ma ni ye shes dbab pa dang / rdo rje khu tshur gyi sngags rgyas phyag rgya 'grub pa'i cho ga'o/ /de ltar gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor bas phyag rgya ni/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du 'da' bar mi mdzad do/ /zhes pa'o/ /bcings pas rgyal po'i bka' las mi 'da' ba ltar/ phyag rgya de lta las 'da' bar mi nus par 'grub par 'gyur te/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'byung ba las/ de nas gzugs brnyan la sogs pa'i sbyor bas phyag rgya bcings pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'da' bar mi mdzad do/ /zhes pa nges pa bskyed nas/ las ston par byed pa'i sngags kyi las gang yin pa de nges par nyid du 'grub par byed do/ /phyag rgya dang sngags thams cad brjod par 'dod pa'i sems dang ldan pas mngon sum du 'dra bar rang gi phyag rgya dang /

lha'i nga rgyal tshang bas phyag rgya thams cad bcing ba dang / cho ga thams cad nan tan bya'o/ /zhes so/ /sngon 'gro dang 'grub chog gnyis kyang rim bzhin 'byung ba ni/ thal mo khong stong dam du sbyar ba ni mnyam pa'i thal mo dang / yid kyis rigs lnga yab yum phan tshun thabs shes mngon par 'dod pa dang bcas par sngon du phyogs par reg par bsam/ chos kun phan tshun rjes su mtshon pa ste/ gcig la gcig gnas pa'o/ /sbyong rgyud las/ thal mo dam du sbyar ba las/ /sor mo thams cad bsnol ba ni/ /rdo rje thal mor bka' stsal te/ /rab tu bsdams phyir rdo rje bsnams/ /zhes pas/ mnyam pa'i thal mo las sor mo rnams kyi tshig gsum pa rnams phan tshun bsnol ba ni rdo rje thal mo ste/ sor mo bcu rigs lnga yab yum/ de phan tshun mi phyed par 'dren pas na/ rdo rje thal mo'o/ /yid kyis lha phan tshun gcig la gcig 'dres shing rjes su zhugs par bsam mo/ /rdo rje thal mo las sor mo thams cad dam du bsdams nas gcig la gcig lag pa'i rgyab tu gcer ba ni rdo rje bsdams pa ste/ yid kyis lha rnams phan tshun ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo/ /de 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi dkyil chog las/ lha rnams reg pa dang phan tshun rjes su zhugs pa dang ro gcig tu gyur pas mos pa spyod nges par 'byed pa'i cha'i rang bzhin du lhag par yang bya'o/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i stong pa nyid do/ /bandha ni 'ching ba ste/ khams gsum gyi bag chags kyi 'ching ba gzhig dka' ba'o/ /traṭa grol cig pa'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa snying khar lan gsum du bral zhing / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dang khams gsum gyi bag chags kyi 'ching ba gzhig dka' ba rang bzhin 'od gsal ba bsgoms pas gcod par bsam la/ de rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar bsam mo/ /badzra a be sha zhes brjod la/ rdo rje 'bebs par bsgom ste/ rdo rje bsdams pa bcings pa'i srin lag gi rtsa bar mthe bong btsugs te snying khar bskyod cing /

a zhes bya bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes dang po'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po yin pa dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po 'od dmar po 'bar ba/ rang gis dang po ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i dus su slob dpon gyis bskyed pa'i snying kha'i zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje la zhugs pas lus kun tu gang bar bsam/ de ltar ye shes babs pa de brtan par bya ba ni/ de nyid 'dus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mor/ tiṣṭha badzra sogs te/ bsgyur na/ bdag la rdo rje gnas shing brtan par gyur cig bdag brtag pa'i bdag nyid du gyur cig bdag la thugs shin tu gnas shing / dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'o/ /hūm̐ bzhugs pa'i sa bon/ ha bzhi ni ye shes bzhi'o/ /ho mnyes shing dbang du byed pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog par/ badzra muṣṭi zhes 'byung bas/ de brjod cing rdo rje khu tshur dam rgya bcings te rdo rje khu tshur du bsgoms la/ oṃ badzra muṣṭi bam̐/ zhes brjod pas phyag rgya bcings pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur te/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings las/ /phyag rgya thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu lha bskyed pa sogs ni gzhan phan 'od zer las/ ye shes dbab cing brtan par byas pa'i rjes la/ zhes gsungs pas/ gzugs can gyi sbyor ba'i rjes la rang lhar bsgom pa yin te/ 'dir rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sbyong rgyud kyi tshe dpag med las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad zos te kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' rnal 'byor chig ldan bsgom pa yin la/ de'i bskyed tshul tshe dpag med nas 'byung ba/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis bsgom pa byas nas kyang /

/a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon de'i dbus su/ /bsam nas dam tshig phyag rgya dag /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du/ /sgrub pa pos ni bsgyur bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin rlobs/ /lta 'og go rim ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i/ chos thams cad sogs tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis/ swa bhā was stong nyid du bsgom pa/ sngags de bsgyur ba/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i bdag nyid nga'o/ /a las zhes pas gdan/ rang gi zhes pas sa bon hūm̐/ dam tshig ces pas rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ de bzhin zhes pas hūm̐ gis mtshan pa sogs/ lha'i zhes pas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ de ltar bsgom pa yang / a ba ta ra'i 'grel par/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i skye bos/ sgrub pa po bdag gam/ gzhan la yang rung ste/ rnam smin gyi phung po bshig nas sems kyis lha'i cha lugs rdzogs par bsgom pa ni dam tshig sems dpa' 'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas zhes sogs kyi/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ sngags kyang shāka thub nas 'byung / phyag rgya ni/ mnyam par gzhag pas dpral bar ni/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi thal mo sbyar/ /sangs rgyas bde gshegs bskyed rnams kyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi phyag rgyar bshad/ /rnal 'byor rig pas mgrin phyogs su/ /thal mo snyim par sbyar ba ni/ /rtag tu padma'i rigs nyid kyi/ /padma'i phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /snying khar gung mo mtha' sbyar ba/ /rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /dam tshig phyag rgya 'dzin byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /lta 'og ces sogs kyi/ sangs rgyas lnga yi dbang bskur ba/ phyag na rdo rje'i skabs nas sngags rnams 'byung / phyag rgya rnams shāka thub nas 'byung / rnal 'byor chig ldan 'di la ye shes pa dgug gzhug

phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab mi byed pa ni/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ kun gyi lhag ma gang yin pa/ /nyi tshe ba de spang bar bya/ /zhes pa'i 'grel pa de nyid snang chen du/ /nyi tshe ba zhes pa ni/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug dang / phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab spang bar bya/ zhes so/ /'dir kha cig gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba'i dang po rdo rje snying khar phab pa la/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug yin zer ba dang / kha cig ye shes pa dgug gzhug chad do zer ba rang gis rgyud 'grel ma mthong bar zad do/ /stan thog gcig tu 'dug nas kyang / /lam lnga nyams su blang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ thar pa'i 'dra 'bag lam du bya ba'i tshul 'di ni bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul rnams rnal 'byor pas stan thog gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i dbang du byas/ lam gyi dang po bdud kyi las spong ba dang / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ dge ba chung ngu bsgrub pa/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni tshogs kyi lam mo/ /sor mo rnams la rigs lnga yab yum du bsam pa ni sbyor lam drod do/ /reg par bsam pa sngags rgya dang bcas pa ni rtse mo'o/ /rjes su zhugs par bsam pa sngags rgya dang bcas pa bzod pa'o/ /'dres par bsam pa sngags rgya dang bcas pa ni chos mchog ste/ nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag go /sdig pa thams cad bral bar bsam pa sngags rgya dang bcas pa ni mthong lam skye ba'i sngon du bgegs bsal ba'o/ /ye shes dbab pa sngags rgya dang bcas pa ni mthong lam gyi rtogs pa bskyed pa'i gdams ngag go /brtan par bsam pa sngags rgya dang bcas pa ni/ sgom lam sa dgur chos nyid kyi rtogs pa goms par byed pa'o/ /rang rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs sngags rgya dang bcas pa ni/ byang sems sa bcu pa nyid nges don du chos kyi skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'o/

/dbang bskur ba sngags rgya dang bcas pa ni/ sangs rgyas gong ma rnams kyis dbang bskur cing byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de ltar bdag rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i zhes pa nas/ 'di nas brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ ngo mtshar dang ni rtsod pa dang / /khro dang zhum dang nges bzung dang / /dad dang dga' ba nyid la ni/ /tshig gcig lan gnyis 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa e ma ho sangs rgyas sogs la sbyar nas bshad/ 'di'i bar mchan yin/ ched du brjod pa'i bar ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /mchod pa 'bul ba bstod pa dang bcas pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku la tshangs pa la sogs pas 'khor lo rtsibs stong gi yon phul nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pa'i tshul lam du byed pa'o/ /bzlas pa dmigs pa dang bcas pa bya ba ni/ sprul pa'i skus gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par chos gsungs pas/ gdul bya de dag theg pa gsum gyi lam la bkod pa la sogs pas sems can gyi bsam pa tshim par mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang mchod bstod bya ba ni/ chos kyis tshims pa'i gdul bya rnams kyis rang rang gi ston pa la bsnyen bkur dang / yon tan brjod pa sogs kyis mnyes par byas pa'o/ /de ltar bdag bskyed ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing / /zhes pas bstan to/ /bum bzlas sogs ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa dri yi chus/ /rab tu bkang ste bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas rnam rgyal dang / dbang bskur rin chen chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa lnga ni bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas dbang gi bum pa lnga ste drug bshad la/ las bum rgyud 'di'i dbu zhabs su tshig zur tsam yang ma gsungs pas/ rin chen bzang pos dharmā pa la la gsan nas kun rig stod lugs pa rnams dang / jo bo chen po rje'i lugs rtsa snur 'dzim gsum sogs mkhas grub de dag gis ma mdzad la/ da lta yo ga stod smad kyi lugs bsres nas byed/ lung du rdo rje 'byung ba drangs nas/

las bum du rdo rje gnod sbyin skyed par byed la/ de ltar byed na lha bum so bdun dang gang bum 'jug sgo'i bum pa sogs bshad pas de dag ci'i phyir mi byed/ rang gi sems mnyam par zhog cig zung 'jug gsal ba las/ de la gser ram yang na dngul/ /zangs sam 'jim pa'i ngo bo'ang rung / /ji ltar rnyed pa'i bum pa zhig /blangs te brtul zhugs can gyis bzhag /bum pa de dag nang nas ni/ /rnam rgyal mtshan nyid ldan par bya/ /sor mo brgyad kyi tshad kyi ni/ /mgrin pa mtho zhing rnam par mdzes/ /sor mo gnyis kyi mchu 'phyang ba/ /lte ba'i rgyar ni mtho lnga pa'o/ /gal te de las tshad gzhan na/ /yon bdag dge bar 'gyur ma yin/ /nag po rnam par spang ba dang / /rtsa ba dor zhing ma 'byar ba/ /bum gang rnam par spang ba dang / /de bzhin gas pa med pa bzung / /bam̐ gyi yi ge las byung ba/ /rin chen rnam pa cher 'bar ba'o/ /gzhan pa rnams la nges med de/ /ji ltar mdzes pa rab tu brtag /ces so/ /mtshan brjod dkyil chog las/ gser sogs rgyu las byung ba yi/ /lto che mgrin pa ring ba dang / /mchu 'phyangs nag po ra ri med/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma byas pa la/ /gtsang ma'i gos kyis mgul pa dkri /zlum byas lcug mas kha brgyan bya/ /chu mchog ldan pas bum pa ru/ /bya kri seṃ kri ha sa dang / /utpa la dang kar ni ka /swo ba 'bras dang ma sha sran/ /nas dang til dang gro rnams dang / /shel dngul mu tig byu ru dang / /gzhan yang dri rnams thams cad blug /de nas ras dkar steng du ni/ /me tog gcal bkram bum pa bzhag /de la byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /bum pa rang bzhin med bsam ste/ /bhrum̐ las mtshan nyid bzang ldan bskyed/ /de yi nang du chu skyes dang / /zla ba dang ldan rig pa yis/ /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed/ /dgug mchod sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /byang chub sems chus gang bar bsam/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra ba las/ 'dir lha thams cad skad cig gis bskyed pa gzhan phan 'od zer du gsungs la/

sbyong rgyud las/ snga ma bzhin du bum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /dbang bskur bar ni rab tu brtag /ces gsungs so/ /oṃ bha sogs ni gzhan phan 'od zer las/ brjod pas skad cig gis 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa bris bzhin pas ches rdzogs pa mdzes par bsam/ zhes gsungs la/ 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa dgos pa yang / smṛrti'i kun rig gi dkyil chog las/ rlung dang me chu de dkyil du/ /gser gyi sa gzhi bsgom par bya/ /suṃ las ri rab chen po bsam/ /zhes gsungs/ sbyong rgyud las/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi/ /them skas bzhi yi phreng ba dang / /seng ge ba glang lda ldis brgyan/ /do shal dril bu rnga yab ldan/ /rdo rje rin chen padma dang / /rgya gram pa yi phyag rgyas mtshan/ /thig brgyad dang ni ldan pa dang / /phyi yi sgo khyud rnams kyis brgyan/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra ba la/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs bcu drug /rim pa gsum dang ldan pa la/ /rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ /zhes dang / dgu yi char ni bgos pa la/ /sgo dang sgo khyud sum char bya/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol tu/ /gling bzhi po ni bri bar bya/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /thig skud brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /zhes pa ni/ tshangs thig bzhi'i shar du cha chen brgyad/ lho nub byang gsum du cha chen brgyad de/ shar mtha' nas nub mtha'i bar la cha chen bcu drug re re'ang cha phran bzhi bzhir bsgo ba ni/ sdom 'byung las/ mtshan ma dbye ba drug cu bzhir/ /thig gi khams rnams nges par gdab/ /ces gsungs so/ /slob dpon a bhya ka ras/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar mtha' nas nub kyi mtha'i bar la cha phran dgu bcu go drug tu bshad pa ni lung 'di rnams dang 'gal zhing / lugs de rgyud rnams nas go drug pa'i lung tshig gcig kyang bshad pa med do/

/'og gzhi logs dang steng thog dang / /sgo dang rta babs lnga yis bsdus/ /'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rjer 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo las/ rdo rje'i rnam pa'i stegs bu dang / /rin chen sna tshogs gzhal med khang / /zhes dang / 'jig rten gsum snang gi dum bu gcig pa'i 'grel par/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du gzhal yas khang bsgom pa yin no/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i rgyar cha chen bcu gnyis dpangs cha chen gcig phyogs bzhi'i dbus ra la cha chen gnyis/ rtsa ba dang rtse mo'i phra sa la cha phran gnyis/ sked pa'i sbom sa la cha phran phyed dang bzhi/ rwa g.yas g.yon/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ chu srin kha nas chu srin bar/ /rta babs sgo las gsum 'gyur te/ /zhes dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ ka ba'i rtse nas mthon rtse mo/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'od po che/ /zhes gsungs pas/ chu srin nas chu srin bar la cha chen gsum mo/ /logs ni/ logs la rtsig pa pha gu dang / /do shal mda' yab pu shu 'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de la nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzungs las/ sa phyogs de rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ them skas bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyar dpag tshad lnga/ dpangs su dpag tshad gsum pa zhig 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar la cha chen brgyad/ cha phran sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dpag tshad lnga lnga dgos pas cha phran drug re dang / lnga gnyis re thob la/ lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /ces pa'i nang ma rtsig pa'i sa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa lnga sbrags yod pa'i dpangs su cha phran bcu drug pha gu cha phran gcig do shal cha phran gnyis/ gser gyi ska rags cha phran gcig gi lnga cha gcig dang bcas pa la/ cha phran bcu dgu dang / lnga cha gcig 'byung la de rnams la dpag tshad gsum 'byung bas/

dpangs su dpag tshad gsum pa zhes bya'o/ /thog la/ ko sa la'i rgyan las/ mtha' gcig rdo rje'i thig la brten pa/ gcig ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus la brten pas te/ de ltar na ka ba brgyad du 'gyur zhes gsungs pas/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi phyogs mdog la cha phran gcig gi lnga cha/ ka ba cha phran bcu drug gzhu ring thung gnyis la cha phran re re/ dpal mchog gi 'grel pa las/ ka ba brgyad kyi steng rdo rje phreng ba zlum pos yongs su bskor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas gdung la cha phran gnyis/ bya 'dab la thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che rnam par spel ba'i mda' yab dang mda' yab kyi steng rin po che'i drwa mig sor bzhi pa'i pu shu lha'i rdo kra ma shi ka mas grub pa'i pu shus bskor ba'i lcam gyi rtsa ba rdo rje gdung zlum gyi steng na yod pa la cha phran gcig de'i steng du gtso bo'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i rtsig pa zlum po la cha phran gsum pa/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran gcig do shal cha phran gnyis/ rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres pa la cha phran gcig de'i thog rnams la cha phran gcig gi phyed/ de'i steng du rtsig pa cha phran gnyis/ pha gu cha phran phyed/ do shal gyi sa cha phran gnyis su lnga cha gcig gis ma thus pa dang bcas pa 'di rnams la 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng nas/ thog gi nang mtha' man chad la cha phran sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pas/ rgya dpangs mnyam por 'dod pa zhes 'dis mtshon pa'o/ /de'i stang du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog cha chen gcig gis mdzes pa'o/ /sgo dang zhes pa ni tshangs thig gi steng rtsig pa'i dbus su brgyad cha phyis pa sgo zhes gsungs pas/ tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du cha phran gnyis gnyis te/ sgo yi zhang tshad cha chen gcig /sgo khyud kyang ni de yi tshad/ /ces gsungs pas/ sgo khyud kyang cha chen gcig sgo 'gram sgo logs de yi phyed/ /ces gsungs pas/ sgo 'gram sgo logs gnyis kyi nang tshad cha phran gnyis gnyis su gsungs na'ang /

sgo logs kyi nang la cha phran gsum dang / phyi la cha chen gcig byas na legs snyam mo/ /rtsa ba'i sgo la ni sgo med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sgo khyud kyi phyi mthar sgo 'jug pa yin no/ /them re bzhi dang bcas pa'i sbom phra cha phran gyi bzhi cha/ sgo glegs g.yas g.yon gyi zheng tshad cha phran gnyis gnyis/ dpangs su cha chen gnyis/ bri cha la/ gnyis pa bzhi cha bzhi ru bsil/ /zhes pa'i cha phran gsum pa ka ba'i sa/ /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /ces pa'i phyi ma pha gu'i sa'i nang mtha' nas cha phran gcig dor ba dang / drug pa phyed gdab phyi yang phyed/ /ces pa'i phyi ma pu shu'i sa'i nang mtha' nas cha phran gcig dor ba'i sa ka ba 'dzugs pa'i sa yin la/ ka ba'i zheng du cha phran gcig dpangs su cha phran lnga pa'i ka ba bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa ste/ sbyong rgyud las/ rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /them skas bzhi yi phreng ba dang / /seng ge ba glang rnams kyis brgyan/ /ces dang / dpal mchog las/ bsam gtan rnams kyi rta babs bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bsam gtan dang po na rtog gcod me lta bu ste dmar po/ gnyis pa na dga' bde chu lta bu ste sngo/ gsum pa na 'byung rngub rlung lta bu ste ljang / bzhi pa na mi g.yo ba sa lta bu ste ser/ snam bu dang po'i g.yas g.yon gyi mchur cha phran bcu drug sgo logs kyi g.yas g.yon snam bu dang po'i rgyar cha phran gsum/ dkyus su cha phran lnga/ snam bu gnyis pa'i sgo gdong gi rtsig pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi mchur cha phran bcu bzhi/ sgo logs kyi g.yas g.yon du zheng du cha phran gnyis/ dkyus su cha phran lnga/ snam bu gsum pa'i rtsig gdong gi g.yas g.yon gyi mchur cha phran bcu gnyis/ sgo logs kyi g.yas g.yon gyi zheng du cha phran gcig dkyus su cha phran lnga/ snam bu gsum pa man dang / sgo khyud sogs kyi rtsig pa dpangs mnyam mo/ /snam bu bzhi pa mchur cha phran bcu/ zheng du cha phran lnga pas sgo logs kyi rtsig pa'i steng bkab pa thog phub dang /

snam bu bzhi mthun pa'o/ /sgo sgo khyud kyi steng ni phyogs mdog rin po che'i spang leb g.yas su cha phran gyi phub pa'o/ /rta babs de'ang slob dpon shra dha ka ra warmas/ rta babs ya phub dag la ni/ /cha gcig dor ba cha chen phyed/ /mchur ni cha chen bzhi pa ste/ /skas la sogs pa ji ltar gyur/ /rta babs cha gcig padmar gnas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo cha gnyis pa/ /mchu dang zheng mnyam gdugs kyi tshad/ /cha gcig pa la yu ba phyed/ /'khor lo'i ngos gnyis thad kar ni/ /ri dwags gnyis ni mnyam gnas pa/ /rta babs la brten 'khor lo phyogs/ /shin tu 'byar min rgyang ring min/ /rdo rje rin chen yu ba can/ /de tshad ri dwags kyi rgyab tu/ /cha chung gcig dor thig la brten/ /rdo rje rin chen yu ba phyed/ /ba dan dril bur ldan pa yis/ /mdzes pa rta babs yin par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pas/ snam bu steng ma'i dbus su rgyar cha chung gnyis pa/ dpangs su cha chung gcig pa'i padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa/ bden pa bzhi lan gsum du bzlas nas mtshon pa'o/ /padma las g.yas g.yon du cha chung re dor ba ri dwags gnyis/ zheng dang dpangs su cha chung gnyis mgrin pa dang bcas pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo la lta ba/ de'ang nang pa sangs rgyas pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la/ mu stegs kyi rtag chad kyi lta ba mtshon pa'i ri dwags mi lta ba'o/ /ri dwags kyi mjug ma nas cha chung gcig dor bar/ cha chung gcig pa'i yu ba'i steng du/ cha chung gcig pa'i rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog can la/ ba dan dang dril bu btags pa dang / snam bu gnyis pa'i zur du dril bu las 'phyang ba'i rtse gcig pa dang / gnyis pa'i ba dan rin po che'i rgyan phreng sna tshogs dang bcas pas mdzes pa/ de ltar ba dan bcu drug 'phyar ba'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i steng du gdugs zheng du cha phran gnyis la/ dpangs su cha phran lnga pa dkar po la/ dra ba phyed pa/

dpangs su cha phran phyed kyis brgyan pa'o/ /thog phub 'di rdo rje dbyings dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sogs spyi'i yin no/ /sgos kun rig gi dkyil 'khor la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i rtsig pa'i shar gyi nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar la cha chen brgyad yod pa'i phyogs mdog lnga cha can gyi dbus su lha snam rgyar cha chen bdun pa/ dpangs su cha chen phyed pa'i dbus su gar bu/ rgyar cha chen drug pa/ dpangs su cha chen bzhi dang / cha phran gcig pa'i steng dang / gser gyi ska rags man gyi dpangs mnyam pa'i thog phub pa'i bya 'dab la mda' yab pu shus mdzes pa/ gar bu'i dbus su gzhal yas khang steng ma gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ sgo phyi ma'i phyed kyi tshad dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ lte ba zlum po rgyar cha chen lnga pa/ dpangs su cha phran gsum pa/ sked pa gsum cha/ cha chung gcig pa'i rtsibs dag la/ rtsibs mchu ru cha chen gcig pa'i mtha' la mu khyud cha phran gcig gis bskor ba/ rtsibs kyi nang rnams dang / gong ras khrol tshags su yod pa/ 'og gzhi'i phyogs mdog gi steng na padma'i sdong po bcu gcig 'dab ma zla gdan dang bcas pa la cha chung gcig ste/ rgyar yang cha chung gnyis pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug gi gdan/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang dpangs mnyam mo/ /lte ba'i steng du gar bu/ rgyar 'khor lo'i lte ba dang mnyam pa/ dpangs su cha phran drug gi steng du/ ka ba dpangs su cha phran bdun pa/ rdo rje dang rin po che dang padma dang / rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i ka ba brgyad/ gzhu ring thung / rdo rje'i gdung zlum yan phub pa rnams sngar dang 'dra/ mi mnyam pa gru bzhi ste/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzhal yas khang gi rtsig pa'i nang mtha' shar nas/ nub mtha'i bar dang / 'og phyogs mdog nas steng gi tog gi 'og mig mang ris gru bzhi pa'i bar mnyam mo/

/kha cig tog gzhal yas khang gi tshad la the ba byas pa ni/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi/ mgo'i steng na mgo rgyan/ rtse phran/ gtsug tor yod kyang / lus kyi dpangs la mi the bas mi 'thad pa yin no/ /gzhal yas khang nang ma la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan med do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ni dpal mchog las/ mi mnyam med pas gru bzhi ste/ /zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo yang dag bris/ /zhes pa'i bar bzhin no/ /zhal bzhi ni rigs bzhi bsdus pa mtshon pa'o/ /mnyam bzhag ni dus rtag tu chos kyi dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa mtshon pa'o/ /rnam snang gi byang chub kyi sems phar phyin rdzogs pas/ sbyong ba'i rgyal por gdul bya la bstan la/ de la grol ba dang / sgrol ba dang / dbugs 'byin pa la gnas pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la dgod pa'i yon tan bzhi yod pa des/ shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi bstan/ kun rig nyid sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pas rgyal mchog tu bstan/ de la yon tan bzhi yod pas/ lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi bstan/ kun rig nyid sher phyin rdzogs pas shākya'i rgyal por bstan/ de la yon tan bzhi yod pas nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi bstan/ kun rig nyid brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin rdzogs pas me tog cher rgyas su bstan/ de la yon tan bzhi yod pas/ byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi bstan/ rnam thar sgo gsum dang / sngar 'dus ma byas pa dang bzhi/ yum bzhi/ 'byung bzhi dag pas yum bzhi/ stong pa nyid bcu drug gi ngo bo dam tshig sems dpa' sogs dang / dbang gi sems dpa' sogs dang / chos kyi sems dpa' sogs dang / las kyi sems dpa' sogs so/ /rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog ces pa ni/ rdo rje las zhal dkar ba bskyed pa'i bar/ phyag gnyis sngo skya/ lhag ma sngo ba/ zhal gyi 'og logs nas/ sked pa'i bar dmar skya/ brla gnyis ser skya/ byin pa man chad dkar po/ byang chub kyi sems sbyin pa sgeg mo/

yang dag pa'i tshul khrims phreng ba ma/ chos la dmigs pa'i bzod pa glu ma/ byang chub chen po spro ba'i brtson 'grus gar ma/ mtshungs par spro ba'i shes rab dhu pe ma/ yang dag par lta ba'i bsam gtan me tog ma/ thar pa'i snang ba bskyed pa'i smon lam mar me ma/ zag pa med pa'i phung po lnga'i rang bzhin dri chab ma/ dad pa lcags kyu/ brtson 'grus zhags pa/ dran pa lcags sgrog ting nge 'dzin 'bebs pa/ kun rig nyid stong nyid bcu drug tu rtogs pa'i ye shes/ skal bzang gi byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug tu bstan/ kun rig nyid kyi bden pa bcu drug tu rtogs pa'i ye shes/ nyan thos chen po bcu drug tu bstan/ kun rig nyid kyis rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung dang lugs bzlog thugs su chud pas rang rgyal bcu gnyis bstan/ zhi bas mi thul ba rnams la 'jig rten gsum snang la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams bstan to/ /sbyong rgyud las/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras bcas 'khor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bdag ldan zhing / /lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor gyis/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥthugs rje'i bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /gsang ba'i bcing bas bcings nas ni/ /zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang / /de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du byas/ /mtheb gnyis nang du bkug nas kyang / /bskyod par gyur na dbang du gyur/ /de nas mtshan ma skyes nas ni/ /thog mtha' med par mngon sum mthong / /argham̐ mchog ste gsang ba la sogs pa/ /dbyangs snyan pa yi bstod dang lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces so/ /spyan drangs te zhes pa'i phyag rgya ni/ de nyid snang bar/ rdo rje gnyis bcings las lag ngar bsnol te/ lag pa gnyis ka'i mdzub mo lcags kyur byas la/ gung mo dang / mthe bong gi se gol gdab pa ni/ rdo rje se gol gyi phyag rgya ste/ zhes so/ /rin chen 'bar bar/

ma lus sems can sogs dang / rab gnas rgyud chung las/ chos rnams kun gyi sogs dang / legs grub las/ bde bar gshegs sogs dang / mchod pa 'di dag 'bul ba'i go rim legs grub bzhin byas par snang ngo / /rdo rje 'byung ba las/ phyag 'tshal ba'i sngags/ ka ya waka sogs dgug gzhug gi dgos pa ni/ de nyid snang bar/ dgug pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang ngam/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas spyan drangs pa'o/ /gzhug pa ni/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor du bcug nas/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa gcig tu bya ba dang / dam tshig sems dpa' la bcug nas/ sems dpa' gnyis gcig tu bya ba'o/ /bcing ba ni sgrub pa dang / bsgrub bya gnyis tha mi dad par bcings pa'o/ /dbang du bya ba ni/ dges pa bsgrub pa ste/ mnyes par bya ba'o/ /zhes so/ /sbyong rgyud las/ de nas mtshan ma bskyed nas ni/ thog mtha' med par mngon sum mthong / /zhes pa'i don/ sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang / phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab dang / las la sbyar ba bsdus pa bstan te/ mu ti ta ko shas/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi 'grel par/ phyag chen ni/ lha rnams kyi sku'i tshul bstan pa ste/ sku'i sgo nas lha'i tshul gsal bar bsgom pa'i rgyur che bas na phyag rgya chen po/ dam rgya ni/ lha rnams kyi sems kyi tshul bstan pa ste/ thugs kyi rnam par thar pa'i mtshan ma phyag rgyar bstan pas lha rnams las mi 'da' bas na dam rgya'o/ /chos rgya ni/ lha rnams kyi gsung gi tshul bstan pa ste/ lha rnams kyi gsung don dam pa'i chos thams cad ston pas na chos rgya/ las rgya ni/ lha rnams kyi spyod pa'i tshul bstan pa ste/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya la sogs pa'o/ /phyag rgya bca' tshul ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis su phral ba la sogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /las la sbyar ba ni/ ngan song sbyong ba'i dbang du byas te/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ ngan song thams cad las 'don pa/

/las kyi rgyal po mchog ces bya/ /kun gyi 'phrin las gcig yin pas/ /des na re re ma bshad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ argham̐ mchog btags gsang ba la sogs pa'i/ /dbyangs snyan pa yi bstod dang lha rdzas kyis/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces pa'i gsang ba la sogs pa ni/ sgeg mo sogs gzugs byad phun sum tshogs pa zur gyis blta ba la sogs pa rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan can te/ de nyid snang bar/ sgeg sogs kyi phyag rgya bcings nas sgeg mo sogs kyi tshul du rnal 'byor pas bsgom pa gang yin pa de ni/ sgeg mo sogs kyi gnas su yid bzhag la/ gzhan gyi phyag rgya bcings te mchod par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /rin chen sna bdun ni/ dgongs pa rab gsal las/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ser po dang / glang chen mche ba drug ldan dkar po dang / rta ljang khu dang / bud med lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa sngo sang ma dang / nor bu cha brgyad pa sngon po/ khyim bdag dmar po mdzod mi zad pa dang ldan pa dang / dmag dpon mdog smug nag g.yon phub/ g.yas ral gri 'dzin par bshad la/ sgron gsal du/ dmag mi'i tshab tu ral gri bshad do/ /'dod yon lnga'i tshigs bcad/ 'jam dpal yon tan kun 'byung gi dkyil chog na yod la/ chos dbyings ye shes/ zhes pa nas/ rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / rnam dag rdo rje zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar/ smṛrtis mdzad pa'i kun rig gi dkyil chog na yod la/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs mtshan brgya de nyid 'dus pa nas gsungs la/ bstod ring la/ rdo rje dril stabs phyag chen dang bcas pa byed pa ni de nyid 'dus pa las/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom byed cing / /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan gcig rab tu brjod par bya/

/zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /sbyong rgyud las/ de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya/ /sems can bkres shing skom la btung ba dang / /phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /de yi gtor ma ji ltar mthun par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ cha gsum ni/ rig pa mchog dang / dpung bzang nas gsungs la/ rigs drug dang yi dwags kyi gtor ma ni/ kha 'bar ma la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs bzhin no/ /gtor ma 'di dag dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du gtong ba ni/ rgyud kyi mchod gshom gyi skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi mthar gshom par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bdag 'jug ni/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs nas/ de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid kyis/ /spyan drangs bdag nyid 'jug par bya/ /bdag nyid kyis ni dbang bskur la/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdag bsgrub ni tshe dpag med las so/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub kyi/ /gnas su slob ma yongs su smin par bya/ /'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub par/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog bskyed du gzhug /de rnams byin rlabs byang chub smon lam gdab/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi chos bsgrags la/ /bsrung ba byas nas brtul zhugs sdom gnas pa/ /rang gi kha nas sngags bzlas gzhug par bya/ /dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma dpal gyi lag gnyis bya/ /me tog rin chen sogs pas de brgyan la/ /yon gyi lag pa bkang ste gzhug par bya/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭha hūm̐ zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sngags la mkhas pa yis/ /sngags 'dis dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /mos pas brtan dang ldan par dam bcas nas/ /sarba bid kyis ji ltar dbang bskur te/ /bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs pas/ /bcu po rnams kyi dbang ni ci dgar bskur/ /de nas lag tu dril dang rdo rje sbyin/ /'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs nas/ /mi dbang dbang phyug 'khor lo thob pa dang /

/sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /sngags grub phyir ni mos pas slob ma la/ /sngags pas bka' ni rab tu bsgo bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dbang bcu ni/ bum pa chu'i dbang / dbu rgyan/ phreng ba/ dar dpyangs gsum cod pan gyi dbang / 'khor lo sogs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi dbang / rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu'i dbang / ming gi dbang ste rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / sna tshogs rdo rje/ rdo rje brtul zhugs te drug rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba/ 'khor lo'i dbang / dam tshig gsum ste dbang bcu'o/ /tshe ldan dbang gis smin par bya ba'i lung sbyor ro/ /tshe 'das sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs padma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi steng du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa bri bar gsungs la/ de'i steng du ro'am/ med na/ sbyong rgyud las/ de yi gzugs brnyan bri ba 'am/ /gur gum gis ni ming yang bri/ /zhes gsungs/ rnam shes dgug pa ni/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ de nas 'od kyi snang ba yis/ /sems can thams cad ngan song las/ /sngags kyi 'od kyis bkug nas ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas bral bar bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa bshad pa dang / de nyid 'dus pa'i khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi skabs nas/ rnam shes dgug pa bshad pas so/ /phyag rgya ni/ khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag rgya yis/ /sdig pa'i phung po dgug par bya/ /zhes dang / de nyid 'dus par/ gsang ba'i lcags kyu bsdams byas te/ /mtha' ma mnyam du brkyangs nas kyang / /shi ba'i mgo bor bzhag nas ni/ /srog ni slar yang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ ṭakki ni 'dod pa/ hūm̐ ni ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ dzaḥni 'gugs pa'o/ /sho dha ni sogs bsgyur na sbyongs shig ngan 'gro thams cad/ de nyid 'dus par/ rdo rje bsdams pa dam byas te/ /gung mo gnyis ni ngos sbyar nas/

/tha ma bzhi ni rtse sprad pa/ /skad cig tu ni sdig bral lo/ /zhes gsungs/ sarba bid sogs bsgyur na/ kun rig sdig pa thams cad sbyongs shig oṃ sarba bid tra ṭa/ kun rig grol cig badzra pā ṇi phyag na rdo rje/ bi spho tra ya rnam par grol cig go /sarba a pā na ya ban dha ni/ ngan song gi 'ching ba thams cad las/ pra mo kṣa ya/ rab tu grol bar gyis so/ /sarba a pa ya ga te bhya/ ngan song gi 'gro ba rnams la/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra sa ma ya traṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig rdo rjes grol cig sbyang ba la kha cig dpyal 'grel zer nas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes bgegs kyi tshegs byas pa de dang 'dral bar byed pa yin zer ba/ de ni ma yin te/ bgegs kyi rnam shes gang na gnas mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na ci'i phyir byed ce na/ spyir bgegs ni gsum ste/ dri za 'chi kha ma'i yid la nye bar brgyug pa zhes bya ba/ 'chi khar de'i drung du bsnyen te tshe 'das pa'i gzugs bzung nas/ gson po rnams la gnod pa byed pa yod pas/ gson po la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ tshar bcad pa dang / gnyis pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre zhes bya ba stobs skyes te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha zhes bya ba stobs chung ste/ tshe 'das pa de'i gzugs bzung nas gnas pa de 'dre des shin tu 'tshe ste gson po la'ang gnod pas/ gson po dang lhan cig gnas pa'i lha la phan gdags pa'i phyir 'dre de tshar bcad de/ de gnyis ni 'ching bar 'gyur bar lung bstan pa'i mdo las bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ tshe 'das nyid la'ang bar do'am/ skye ba blangs kyang rung ste/ las kyi dbang gis bgegs gnod pa'ang srid pas de la'ang phan gdags pa'i phyir/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gi bar gyis bya ste/ sbyong rgyud 'di nyid kyi tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ de nas de yi sdig 'joms lus/ /bgegs dang bral te ci bde bar/ /mtho ris 'jig rten mi yi nang /

/khams gsum par ni ci bder spyod/ /ces bshad pas so/ /sbyong rgyud las/ thal ba yungs kar bye ma sogs/ /rang gi ming smos sngags kyis gdab/ /bzlas pa byas te song nas kyang / /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chur dor ro/ /zhes gsungs/ shāka thub kyi skabs su/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badzra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ sdig pa thams cad bsreg pa'i rdo rje'i ched du zhes so/ /phyir bzlog gi sngags tshan bco lnga gsungs so/ /gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ de nas phyir bzlog bya ba ni/ /yungs kar gyis ni bya ba yin/ /yungs kar me tog dang ldan pas/ /gsang sngags bzlos shing brdeg par bya/ /rus pa'am gos sam ming la ni/ /de rjes chu yis bkru bar bya/ /sdig pa bkru ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /srid gsum dri ma bkru bar bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / bkru ba'i sngags ni rtsa rig tu bshad do/ /sbyong rgyud las/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa ldan/ /tshul khrims rgyu dang rab ldan zhing / /bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan dang / /shes rab thabs kyi rgyu bsgom pa'i/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i smos ci dgos/ /myur du de yi ngan song ni/ /bcom par 'gyur te the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ jo bo rje'i mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil chog dang / rin chen 'bar bar/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /zhes gsungs/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud dang / rma bya chen mo dang / stong chen rab 'joms su/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung la/ slar yang bkra shis tshigs bcad kyis/ /dus gsum du ni khrus bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ de nas bu la sogs pa'i lag tu ming byang 'dzin pas phyag byed du bcug la/ yid kyis tshe 'das dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing / nye ba'i sras brgyad la gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig mdo las gsungs pa spyod 'jug tu drangs pa/

gtso bo rgyal ba sogs so/ /dbang bskur ba ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ ngan song gsum gyi 'jig rten las/ /sems can rnams ni grol ba'i phyir/ /sngags mkhan gzhan la phan brtson zhing / /snying rje can gyi dbang bskur ro/ /de ltar dbang bskur zhing sdig pa byang ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /dmyal ba la sogs sdug bsngal las/ /de ni myur du rnam par thar/ /sdig las rnam grol bdag nyid de/ /dag par gyur pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /rigs su skye bar gyur nas kyang / /de ni rtag tu sangs rgyas dang / /chos 'gro ba ni thob par 'gyur/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas/ /rim kyis byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar sdig pa sbyangs shing dbang bskur bas/ tshe 'das de yi dam gyi lhar gsal la/ de la mchod pa ci 'byor dang / me tog gi char dbab pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /lam bstan pa'i sngags/ oṃ ratne sogs bsgyur na/ dkon mchog rin chen rin chen che/ /rin chen las byung rin chen 'od/ /rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pas/ /sdig pa thams cad sbyong bar gyis/ /tra ta bral bar gyis/ lam sbyong ba'i sngags bsgyur na/ padma padmar las byung ba'i/ /bde ba can du 'gro bar shog /ces pa'o/ /yul lugs la zas gtod ces bya ba sngon byang phyogs kyi yul 'di na byed pa yod de/ rgyud sde dang bla ma brgyud pa'i bshad srol lag len mi shes/ dbang bskur yang ma thob/ thob pa rnams kyang dkyil 'khor du 'jug tshe/ me tog gang la phog dpon slob gnyis kas mi shes/ de'i don gyis dbang bskur tshe me tog phog pa'i lhar bsam la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga rdo rje'i brtul zhugs drug gi dbang bskur/ de nas rdo rje sems dpar bsgyur nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur dgos pa la/ mun nag snang ba med par dpon slob zhugs pa dang 'dra ba'i cho ga sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rgyud sde de nas brgyud pa'i lag len dang 'gal ba gcig byed/

yon bdag gson po rnams dang / rgyud sde dang 'gal ba'i cho ga byed mkhan rnams kyi bsam pa la/ gshin po de dge ba byas sam/ sdig pa gang byas kyang bar dor skyes nas/ skye ba snga ma la dge ba byas kyang / bar dor sdig pa'i snang ba 'char bar bsgom/ gshin po de rigs drug gang du skyes kyang / der ma skyes par/ zas gtod ma byas bar la bar do na yod par bsgom/ zas gtod byed pa'i tshe/ de la dus tshod nam gyi tshe byed ces/ bla ma dang yon bdag gnyis kas bon po la gros 'dri/ de nas zas gtod bsags nas de la 'phrog pa'i bgegs yod par bsgom/ de la bgegs bskrod par bsgom/ de nas bgegs rnams med nas/ shi ba de dngos su yod par bsgom/ zas de thob pa dang / shi ba de dang gson po rnams bral bar bsgom/ shi ba'i sems de'ang re thag chod nas/ kho rang skye ba len par yon mchod rnams zhal 'chams nas/ zhal nas 'don cing sems kyis kyang bsgom mo/ /de la yon mchod de rnams thub pa'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun rdzogs des/ tshe 'phos pa ji ltar lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ kyai rgyal po chen po/ 'di nas tshe 'phos pa la/ pha ma'am/ spun nam/ bu la sogs pa nye 'brel rnams kyis bza' ba dang btung ba nyung ngur nyung ngur gtad pa dang / bsngos pa yang bskal pa mang por zad par mi 'gyur bar bza' zhing 'thung ngo zhes 'jig rten pa rnams mchi na/ de ltar lags sam zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgyal po chen po/ gling bzhi pa nas/ stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / stong gnyis stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas dpag tu med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad na bza' ba dang btung ba nyung ngu nyung ngus dus thams cad dang / bskal pa mang por bza' ba'i sems can gzigs pa gsan nam/ rgyal po chen po/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la ci bsam pa'i 'dod pa 'byung ba 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la yod pa yang /

sngon bskal pa mang por bsod nams kyi tshogs tshad med pa bsags pa las byung ba yin no/ /gnam sam glo bur du byung ba ma yin na bza' ba dang btung ba nyung ngu de bskal ba'i mtha'i bar du mi zad pa de rigs lags sam/ kyai rgyal po chen po/ tshe ma 'phos pa'i pha ma dang spun gnyis la gcig 'brel par 'dzin par/ phan par 'dod pa rnams/ da lta ma shi ba lus dang ldan pa yang / gcig yul gzhan du song nas/ de la pha ma'am bu'am spun gang yang rung bas zas skom mang po sbyin no zhes bsngos pa yang yul gzhan du song ba de'i rmi lam du yang mi 'byung na/ dngos po bza' zhing 'thung ba lta ga la yod/ tshe 'phos nas lus dang bral ba la bsngos shing gtad pa bza' zhing 'thung ba lta ga la yod/ kyai rgyal po chen po/ tshe 'phos nas sems lus dang bral ba des/ bu dang spun la sogs pas gtad pa'i zas skom dngos po can 'di dag gi sems dngos po med pa gzugs med pa ji ltar bdag po byed par 'gyur/ de'i ci'i phyir zhe na/ bza' ba dang btung ba ni/ lus yod pa'i yan lag gi rtsol ba la rag las na/ sems la lus kyi yan lag de'i rtsol ba yod dam/ rgyal pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar lags na/ tshe 'phos pa las/ 'di nas phan 'dogs pa'i bza' btung dang / bzhon pa dang / gos dang / rgyan legs par btang ba 'di la don ma mchis pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po/ tshe 'phos pa des las dge sdig spyad pa'i rnam smin gyis/ 'gro ba rigs drug tha dad pa gang du skye ba len pa de la/ mi dge ba dang ma 'brel ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba'i las dge ba sna tshogs pa btang na/ mtho ris dang thar pa yang bskyed la/ gal te skye ba blangs pa gcig la bsod nams su 'gyur ba'i las dge ba gcig btang na skye ba blangs pa des nor rnyed pa dang / lo legs pa dang / 'dod pa'i longs spyod 'phel ba dang / 'gro ba gzhan thams cad kyis mchod cing bkur ba'i phan yon yod kyis/

tshe 'phos pa skye ba mi len par gshin gyi 'jig rten na yod pas bza' btung dang / bzhon pa dang / gos rgyan gyi bdag po byed pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rjes chog ni/ me ltar 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg gi skabs nas/ de 'dra'i lus la dbang bskur zhing / /mnyam par gzhag pas bsrungs nas kyang / /mjug tu mngon par mchod nas ni/ /zhes gsungs/ legs grub tu/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /sogs dang / rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /sogs dang / dza ba ri pa'i mchod phreng du/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston cing / /sogs dang / gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ sgeg mo phreng ba sogs gsungs so/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ bzod gsol gyi tshig rnams gsungs shing / bkra shis stong chen rab 'joms las gsungs so/ /cho ga ma dag pa byas pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ spyod rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor legs par ma mthong par/ /gang zhig ji snyed sngags zlos pa/ /des na dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /shi nas ngan song ltung bar 'gyur/ /gti mug dbang gis mi shes par/ /mi gang dkyil 'khor 'bri byed pa/ /de ni mtshams med lnga rnams dang / /'dra ba'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /cho ga dag po byas pa'i phan yon ni/ de nyid las/ cho ga legs par 'bri ba ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen te/ /'dod pa'i gnas ni dam par skye/ /gshed byed rnams dang ro langs dang / /sha za lto 'phye chen po ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gdon rnams dang / /'jigs par 'gyur ba'i bgegs rnams kyis/ /lha yi rigs mthong dam tshig shes/ /rtag tu tshugs par mi 'gyur zhing / /de yi mi dge'i las byang zhing / /ngan song du yang yongs mi ltung / /de yis bsgrubs na nges par ni/ /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /de la byang chub sa bon ni/ /brtan par 'gyur bar dogs pa med/ /ces gsungs so/ /rgyud dang rin chen bzang po'i bshad srol dang /
